environment.neo4j: 5.26.31 community (Compose), heap max 512 MiB, page cache 256 MiB
environment.browser: Google Chrome headless via puppeteer-core (script not committed)

neo4j_container_memory_gib.note: docker stats samples take about 2 s each

projection.neo4j_data_size: 1.2G (/data in the container, including old builds' sample and full projections)

double_store_consistency.one_hop: formula edge sets from /graph equal /entities/{id}/relations for CONTAINS and ASSOCIATED_WITH_PATTERN
double_store_consistency.two_hop: /graph/paths equals /relation-queries for every bencaodian herb (herb_patterns_via_formula), compared on role, position, dosage_raw

dump_load.method: docker compose stop neo4j; neo4j-admin database dump neo4j (same image, data volume mounted); compose start. Load into a new volume with --overwrite-destination=true and a temporary instance on 127.0.0.1:27687
dump_load.cleanup: temporary container and volume removed; the original volume was not overwritten

browser_checks: canvas click selects the formula node
expanding 人参 grows the graph from 7 to 28 nodes
clicking a relation shows its evidence links
hub node shows the truncation notice; expanding stops at 100 nodes with the cap banner
stubbed 503 from /graph shows the service message, retry, and the link back to the entity page
